description: Saves a finished job for XF Model Watch, which re-tests it as new models arrive and emails the person only when a model passes every must-have and ranks higher on their priorities. Needs a signed-in subscriber. Ask the person first: Model Watch keeps the job and its example tasks (encrypted, deletable any time). Pass consent=true only if they agree. Pass the discover session, and either test_session from a finished comparison or the tasks, plus the model they use now. The first check runs as soon as the job is saved. To re-check a job the person already watches, pass check_now with the job's id or title instead (once a day per job; the result is emailed and shown at /account).

check_now.description: Check a job they already watch now: its id or title. Leave out when saving a job.

consent.description: The person agreed to Model Watch keeping this job.

current_model.description: OpenRouter id of the model the job uses now.

runs_per_month.description: Roughly how many times a month the job runs, if known.

test_session.description: From a finished comparison; carries its tasks.

title.description: A short name for the job, in the person's words.

name: watch_job
title: Watch this job (XF Model Watch subscribers)
